item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows sunlight heating a pond, water vapour rising to form a cloud, and moving air carrying the cloud. Kiara links these Earth factors to living things.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Water in the pond is part of the hydrosphere and is essential for life.
options.B: Sunlight heats Earth so that water vapour can form clouds and later bring rain that refills water sources.
options.C: Moving air and rainfall have no effect on which plants and animals can live in a place.
options.D: Habitats for living beings come first, and that produces sunlight, water movement, and air movement.
